method: Normal Samsung Settings > App info > Storage; exact displayed units and rounded values, not a byte-accurate filesystem census. Post-benchmark clean profiles have two archive references and one Hawaii tab after earlier Animal runs; caches reflect each actual app workflow, not identical cache contents. No data/cache clearing for this observation. Shared source archives are outside app-private totals and are the same files. No assumption about OEM filesystem compression or category accounting.
claimBoundary: Smaller observed Settings-reported installed footprint in this exercised profile; not exact bytes, fresh-install default size, all archive storage, or a causal allocation diagnosis.
